body: Coordinator trap (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-20 04:24Z, found by Sol-1cee). In PowerShell, @($s.pendingPrompts).Count returns 1 when the field is null or absent. The /api/state session projection omits pendingPrompts and queuedMessages, so every ad hoc "pending=1" reading tonight was false. Check presence with ($null -eq $s.pendingPrompts), or read the field list. Judge a stuck queue only from status, queuePaused and the send API's notificationDisposition, never from that count.
